name: No-show / Cancel
job: Handle appt_status=no-show and appt_status=cancel only. Reschedule never enters. Drops the contact from WF-03, splits the status tag, sends the rebook SMS burst, then hands to WF-09.

trigger.notes: Sole enroll path is ADD-TO-WF from WF-05. Reschedule routes to WF-03, not here.

named_steps.name: REMOVE-FROM-WF: Drop from WF-03 Reminders
named_steps.comment: REMOVE-FROM-WF WF-03 ec08cae5-3d1f-48bd-9a0d-444626d9a150. Stops any in-flight reminder cadence. Must not remove v2_status_booked (booking state is factual).

named_steps.name: IF: appt_status = no-show
named_steps.comment: Splits the status tag path. Must not tag no-show if source was reschedule (WF-05 already excluded reschedule).

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_status_noshow (no-show branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 tag. Must not remove live booking tags.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_status_cancelled (cancel branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 tag. Fires on the false branch (appt_status=cancel).

named_steps.name: SMS: Rebook after miss + STOP (WF-08)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Transactional; send window None.

named_steps.name: SMS: Rebook +7d (WF-08)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Final rebook nudge before nurture hand-off.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Enroll WF-09 Nurture
named_steps.comment: ADD-TO-WF WF-09 cbc14e90-4507-42cd-afcc-f7410d7f4554. Must not create Sales opps here.
